ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A smart display would complement my Alexa-enabled TV setup, and video calling gives it a useful new role.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa voice control interests me, but I would choose the Show 8 for its screen this time.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Controlling a household device through Alexa would add a practical function to my existing setup.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in Alexa devices, but I would try the Show 8 before adding another voice-control device.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This closely duplicates my existing Fire TV Stick 4K, with no clear reason to replace it now.
